The facts: Person bought a nail gun (射钉枪) and modified it with parts to make a non-standard firearm that uses gunpowder to fire non-standard ammunition. This is a type of illegal firearm manufacturing or possession. In Chinese criminal law, there are offenses: illegal manufacturing, sale, transport, repair, or possession of firearms, ammunition, or components. The specific crime likely is "非法制造枪支、弹药、零部件罪" (illegal manufacturing of firearms, ammunition, components). Also possibly "非法持有枪支罪". The facts: He purchased a nail gun, then modified it into a non-standard gun. That is manufacturing a firearm. So the crime is illegal manufacturing of firearms. Also possession of illegal firearms. Check if there is also "非法改装枪支" which is part of illegal manufacturing. So final answer: [罪名]非法制造枪支<eoa>.
